applies_to: Some adults ages 19-64 when they apply for or renew OHP, starting in 2027.

ways_to_meet.text: Household income above $580 a month before taxes and deductions.
Enrolled in school at least half-time, including high school or GED programs.
At least 80 hours a month of work, volunteering, caregiving, school, or a training or work program.

exemptions.question: Are you American Indian or Alaska Native?
Are you pregnant or were you recently pregnant?
Do you care for a child under 14?
Do you care for someone with a disability or serious health condition for at least 80 hours a month?
Do you have a serious or disabling health condition?
Are you a veteran with a 100% VA disability rating?
Are you in inpatient or residential care?
Were you away from home 7 or more days this month for medical care?
Have you been in drug or alcohol treatment in the past 5 years?
Were you recently released from jail or prison?
Are you meeting SNAP or TANF work rules?
Are you a former foster youth age 19-26?
Do you live in a high-unemployment county or a federally declared disaster area?
